annotations.title: Assess the risk of an identity

description: Scores an identity from 0 (no risk found) to 100 with a verdict (allow, review or deny) and the reasons that added to the score, from any mix of phone number, email address and IP address, each checked in parallel; each signal's own result is under signals. Give at least one of the three. Charged per signal from your balance; the sandbox (a pt_test_ key) is free.

country.description: The two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. GB) of a number given in national format.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the end user, e.g. 203.0.113.1.

phone.description: The phone number, in international format (E.164, e.g. +447700900123), or in national format with the country.

reference.description: Your own id for this check (a sign-up, an order), echoed back.

name: assess_identity_risk
